scope: Correction to newly designed layer reference, before further validation; original numerical failures are retained.
original_assumption: Two FP8 GEMMs with an intervening BF16 activation and FP8 requantization can be compared to ideal FP32 GEMMs at the single-op tolerance.
observed_evidence: At M84, FP32 and FP64 gate references agree exactly. Old ordinary FP32-scale AITER, native FlyDSL E8M0, and Triton scaled MFMA16/32 all produce exactly the same 958 BF16 differences from that ideal reference. Compound pipeline has 15/43008 failures because requantization crosses boundaries. Operand bytes, encoded scales, manual FP8 decoding and 524288 one-product outputs all match exactly.

corrected_contract.per_projection: Keep atol=rtol=1e-2 versus independent FP32-dequantized Torch matmul. Both gate and down are checked.
corrected_contract.whole_layer: Compare native E8M0 packed weights to ordinary unshuffled FP8 GEMM using identical quantized operands and decoded FP32 scales; require exact equality, atol=rtol=0.
corrected_contract.coverage: Empty and two-byte-offset inputs, 7/48/56/84/112/512 rows, three-dimensional input, repeated preparation, graph replay and torch.compile.
corrected_contract.quality: Changing activation quantization still requires real model evals; exact scale-format equivalence is not a quality result.
